_comment: Sounds that the original plays with repeats > 1 (AntSoundManager.play(name, source, unique, repeats, volume) -> AntSound.play -> flash Sound.play(0, repeats)). Only `loops` get loop=true in assets/sounds.json (and only they lose their leading MP3 silence). `notLoops` are sounds that look like loops but are not, see the note. `source` = path:line of the play() call in reference/as3 (checked by sounds.test.ts).

loops.name: SndPortalIdle
loops.note: AntG.sounds.play("SndPortalIdle", this._effect, false, 999); stopped in Portal.as:39

loops.name: SndFuelRefill
loops.note: AntG.sounds.play("SndFuelRefill", view, false, 999); stopped in StationSystem.as:188 and :331

loops.name: SndMusicMenu01
loops.note: manager.play(trackName, cameraAnchor, false, 10, 0.5): 10 repeats = 11 plays, then silence; in practice a loop

loops.name: SndMusicGameplay01
loops.note: same call as SndMusicMenu01 (random pick from _gameThemes)

loops.name: SndMusicGameplay02
loops.note: same call as SndMusicMenu01 (random pick from _gameThemes)

notLoops.name: SndEngineGas
notLoops.note: AntG.sounds.play("EngineGas_snd", actor, 999): 999 lands in the Boolean parameter `unique` (-> true), so repeats stays 1. The engine sound is restarted by ShuttleSystem.playEngineSound whenever !isPlaying(); the sound is played once per call. Kept as a one-shot with its MP3 padding, like the original.

notLoops.name: SndLowFuelAlarm
notLoops.note: played once, re-triggered by a timer every 1000 ms
